<function name="MoveCursorToClosestPosition" parent="PathFollower" type="classfunc">
	<description>Moves the cursor of the path to the closest position compared to given vector.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="pos" type="Vector"></arg>
		<arg name="type" type="number" default="0">Seek type


0 = SEEK_ENTIRE_PATH - Search the entire path length


1 = SEEK_AHEAD - Search from current cursor position forward toward end of path


2 = SEEK_BEHIND - Search from current cursor position backward toward path start</arg>
		<arg name="alongLimit" type="number" default="0"></arg>
	</args>
</function>
